prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls & Interaction Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding tutorial screen showing how to summon, move, hide, and talk to the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple complaints (3 emails) from users confused about how to interact with or control their pet after setup.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Validation Sub-Flow: Insert a photo quality check screen before certificate creation to verify custom pet photo inputs before processing. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or corrupted pet models.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Sign-In Reorder: Move sign-in step to immediately follow the official adoption certificate screen. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after sign-in; placing sign-in right after certificate creation anchors account creation to the newly created pet.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Status Verification Badge: Display a desktop integration status indicator on the waiting screen so users know their display layer is preparing properly. (why: 3 support tickets report pets failing to appear on the desktop when onboarding finishes.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selection Screen: Change the choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode to focus attention on primary adoption options. (why: choose_path has a 23.8% drop-off rate despite taking only 8 seconds median time, indicating decision confusion.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Pet Preservation Hint: Add explicit hint text on sign_in reassuring users that signing in saves their current pet state. (why: 8 support emails mentioned confusion around pets missing or being reset after sign in.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Optimization Hint: Add clear guidelines hint on the photo upload screen explaining photo framing and lighting requirements. (why: 3 support tickets cited failed or misrendered custom pets due to poor source photos.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Desktop Notification: Enable ready notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet background generation completes. (why: The waiting screen has a very long mean time (2336s), suggesting users switch windows while waiting and forget to return.)
